qa_pair.question: Using the RuneGrid tools, find the beast with the highest armor class among SRD 2014 monsters of challenge rating 1 or lower (there is a single top value). What is that creature's walking speed in feet? Answer with just the number.
In the SRD 2014 bestiary, how many monsters of type dragon have a challenge rating between 5 and 10 inclusive? Answer with just the number.
In the SRD 2024 (5.2) bestiary, how many fiends have a challenge rating of 10 or higher? Answer with just the number.
How many level-3 spells in the SRD 2014 list the Wizard among their classes? Answer with just the number.
Find the SRD 2014 monster with the highest challenge rating. How many hit points does it have? Answer with just the number.
How many level-9 spells exist in the SRD 2014 spell list? Answer with just the number.
Of the spells that the RuneGrid combat engine resolves automatically (marked as engine-resolved), which one is a level-3 spell? Answer with its id.
In the equipment catalog used by character creation, which finesse weapon has the largest damage die? Answer with its catalog id.
Among SRD 2014 humanoids with challenge rating 2 or lower, what is the highest hit point total of any single monster? Answer with just the number.
How many more challenge-rating-0 monsters does the SRD 2024 bestiary contain than the SRD 2014 bestiary? Answer with just the number.
